description.from:
**Milestone:** Later, coarse

**Goal.** Coarse until M3 ships. An admin connects a site to a workspace and channel.

**Build.**
OAuth install flow on the notification domain; connection row per site and workspace. Tokens encrypted with the service's KMS key in DynamoDB: per-install tokens are created at runtime, so IaC cannot generate them. Verify every inbound request (`v0:<timestamp>:<body>`, HMAC-SHA256 with the signing secret, reject beyond five minutes, constant-time compare, raw body). `app_uninstalled` and `tokens_revoked` can arrive in either order; either one marks the connection gone and the admin is told. Keep separate from the per-site inbound agent app in Papyrus `docs/slack-agent.md`; converging them is deferred. Stories with Gherkin are written when this starts.

**Acceptance.**
Spec'd when started: forged signature refused; uninstall stops sends and tells the admin.

**Depends on:** kanbus-ff4727
description.to:
**Reworked 2026-11-04:** Ryan reversed the architecture. No new AWS account and no central service; see docs/notifications-plan.md in AnthusAI/Caducus.

**Milestone:** Later, coarse

**Goal.** Coarse until M3 ships. An admin connects a site to a workspace and channel, from the site's own deployment. One Slack app, many sites, nothing shared at runtime.

**Build.**
Package: `channels/slack.py`. Papyrus: OAuth callback in the site's plugin routes; connection row in the site's table. Tokens encrypted with the site's KMS key in DynamoDB: per-install tokens are created at runtime, so IaC cannot generate them. A Slack app has one Events URL but no central service exists here, so no events: uninstall is detected at the next send (`token_revoked`, `account_inactive`), which marks the connection gone and tells the admin. Check the exact error names when building. Verify OAuth `state`. If real inbound is needed later, one signed endpoint in papyrus-monitoring routes by team id. Separate from the per-site inbound agent app in Papyrus `docs/slack-agent.md`. Stories with Gherkin are written when this starts.

**Acceptance.**
Spec'd when started: uninstall stops sends and tells the admin.

**Depends on:** kanbus-ff4727
**Related:** PPY-cc015c
